provenance.how_to_verify: Open the Indigo Book (https://law.resource.org/pub/us/code/blue/IndigoBook.html, CC0), R23 (Constitutions), R23.1 and R23.3, and compare the form and examples with this pattern.

positive.text: P.R. Const. art. I, § 7 protects property.
Under P.R. Const. art. III, § 5, members qualify.
See P.R. Const. art. II, § 10 and P.R. Const. art. IX.

negative: The P.R. constitution was ratified long ago.
P.R. Const. Convention delegates met in 52 sessions.
Article 5 of the P.R. charter, section 3, is short.

note: R23.3: state (and territory) constitutions take the U.S. Constitution form with the jurisdiction's T12 abbreviation; us.state.constitution does not accept this abbreviation.
